title: Checkout v3: five-step checkout from cart to confirmation

acceptanceCriteria.text: The cart lists each item with its variant, stock status, quantity stepper and price, and an order summary with a Go to checkout button.
An empty cart shows the empty state with a 'Continue shopping' action.
Shipping collects contact details, the address and the country, and offers Standard (free) and Express delivery.
Payment collects the card details and shows the amount on the Pay button.
If the card is declined, show an error above the card fields so the customer can correct the card and pay again.
Review shows the address, delivery method, payment method and the items in the order before the order is placed.
A valid promo code shows a discount line with the code and the updated total.
After payment, show the order number, the delivery estimate and a receipt toast.
